title: Moonlit Reunion
html:
Moonlit Reunion

Quest Type

Tutorial

Event

By Moon's Grace

Requirements

  • Reach Union Level 17
  • Complete Ominous Star

Description

As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

Steps[]

  1. Jinzhou is getting lively lately. Go back and ask around
  2. Find Yangyang, Chixia, and Baizhi
  3. Examine the strange robot
  4. Ask passerby about its origins
  5. Head to the "Wishing Tree"
  6. Go to the Wishing Stall

Gameplay Notes[]

  • This quest is limited.
  • For better experience, please complete Thaw of Eons before participating in this event.
  • Completing the quest awards the player the Rover's Journey trophy A Fable About Moon and Wishes.

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...
(Head to the designated location)
Yangyang: Hello, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). It's me, Yangyang.
Yangyang: How've you been? Is life in Jinzhou treating you well? You know I'm here if you ever need anything.
Chixia: Oh, Yangyang! What's there to be shy about? If you want to see (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), just tell (‍‍himText for male Rover‍/‍herText for female Rover‍‍)!
Chixia: So, what have you been up to these past few days? Feelin' lonely without us around?
Chixia: Wanna go see some fireworks? How about some Moon Shooting? With the festival just around the corner, there's a really cool spot we can take you to.
Festival?
Yangyang: Yes. It'll be the Moon-Chasing Festival in a few days.
Yangyang: Though we celebrate this festival every year in Huanglong, given everything that has happened, this year's Moon-Chasing Festival in Jinzhou is sure to be quite special.
Chixia: Yep, I caught them hanging lanterns all around City Hall. Every street and alley is gonna be glowing, I can't wait to see it all lit up!
Chixia: And we've got special Jinzhou traditions you won't find anywhere else.
Chixia: Like Taoyuan Vale! Folks go there a few days before the festival to write their wishes onto paper, then hang them on branches or toss 'em into Moontree Lodge.
Chixia: They say wishes made during these days are sure to come true. Works like a charm.
Chixia: Wanna give it a go, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)? All you gotta do is write down your wish, real simple! Yangyang, Baizhi and I are already here.
I'll come find you guys.
Chixia: Great!
Chixia: See you at Taoyuan Vale.
(Head to the designated location)
Chixia: Hey, over here!
Chixia: Where have you been lately? Hehe, did you miss us?
Chixia: Oh, anything exciting happened while you were out there? "(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)'s Wild Adventures." Come on, let us in on it!
You tell Yangyang, Chixia, and Baizhi what happened at Mt. Firmament.
Chixia: So ... so you mean that big Mt. Firmament thingie that shocked all of Jinzhou, no wait... that shocked all of Huanglong, was all because of you?!
Chixia: Rover saves the day yet again!
It was a team effort.
Yup. That would be me.
Baizhi: Sentinel and Magistrate resume their positions after Threnodian's defeat. Jinzhou will surely return to peace and harmony.
Baizhi: With the Threnodian defeated, our Sentinel and the Jinzhou Magistrate have resumed their duties. Jinzhou will have peace and prosperity once more.
Yangyang: Yes. Oh (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), and the Sentinel did give you certain insights about your memory loss. While there's still much to uncover, at least we're on the right track.
Chixia: At... Long... Last. We can finally have some fun!
Chixia: Hey, what better time to celebrate than the Moon-Chasing Festival, right?
Chixia: You, me, Yangyang, and Baizhi. The four of us will have a great time munching on treats and enjoying looking at the full moon!
Chixia: And let's not forget about the Moonlit Fair! It's exclusive to Jinzhou, happening only on the night of the festival. There's so much to eat, drink, play, and see!
Chixia: Wait till I show you the biggest lantern show of the Fair! I know a spot that has the perfect view!
Yangyang: That's a wonderful idea, let's enjoy the festival together, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). I'm sure there'll be plenty of interesting things to pique your interest.
Baizhi: Everyone in Jinzhou will be there. There's a high chance we'll run into some familiar faces.
Sounds very exciting.
Chixia: Then it's a deal! Mark my words, with us around you'll be in for a Moon-Chasing Festival you'll remember for life!
Chixia: Shoot, we got so distracted with everything else, I almost forgot about your wish for the Wishing Tree.
Chixia: It's a huge deal—you won't wanna miss it!
Huge deal?
Chixia: That's right. Remember what I told you about wishes made under the Wishing Tree coming true?
Yangyang: There are stories of it flying around... Especially in recent years, the wishes people make on the eve of the Moon-Chasing Festival seem to come true in one form or another.
Chixia: A few years ago, Jinzhou had endless rain. Yangyang wished for clear skies for the Festival and a perfect Moonlit Fair.
Chixia: And guess what? The rain stopped, and the moon was full and bright.
Yangyang: Exactly. I thought I'd try my luck, but it actually happened.
Yangyang: Perhaps just a pleasant coincidence? The Moon-Chasing Festival does have a history of such coincidences. Maybe there's something to the Wishing Tree's magic after all.
Chixia: Or maybe there's a mysterious hero inside the Wishing Tree, making our dreams come true!
Chixia: Just like you, Yashaa. You save the world without anyone noticing. If you're not in the next season of Hero Plays, I'm out.
Chixia: All right, better get to it before we chatter ourselves away again.
Chixia: The Wishing Tree is just up ahead. Off you go.
Are you guys not going?
Chixia: We've already made our wishes.
Chixia: Mine's for the Moonlit Fair to draw in a huge crowd and for everyone to have a fantastic time.
Chixia: As for Yangyang, she wished for endless happiness and happy reunions for all families.
What about Baizhi?
Chixia: She, um... She's not really into wishes.
Baizhi: Don't mind me, I tend not to make wishes. But if I did, it would probably be similar to Yangyang's.
Chixia: There, you're the last one left, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). Oh, and don't forget about Abby! I'm sure the little guy doesn't want to miss out.
Knock Knock, Abby.
Rise and shine, Abby.
Abby: Yawn... Who's there...? What's going on...?
Want to make a wish at the Wishing Tree?
Abby: Make... A wish...? I'm tired... Just make one for me...
Abby: I want... lots of goodies to eat... I don't ever want to be hungry again...
Okay, go back to sleep now.
Never mind, go back to sleep now.
Abby: Phew... Huff...
Chixia: Well, what did Abby say?
Yangyang: Well, after you're finished at the Wishing Tree, come see us at the Moonlit Fair. Chixia and I will be helping out with preparations.
Chixia: Hehe, I'll be over at Qingxi's Moon Shooter stall. It's not fully set up yet, but I can give you a sneak peek.
I'll keep that in mind.
(Head to the designated location)
Patty: Moon-Chasing Festival. Wishes. Moon-Chasing Festival. Wishes, wishes, wishes...
Rover: Is that... a robot?
Patty: Wishes. Wishes...
Rover: It seems to be malfunctioning.
Rover: Can't tell who left it here. I should try asking around.
(Talk to passerby)
Rover: Excuse me, have you seen this robot before? Do you know where it's from?
Rover: It's... acting a bit strangely.
Passing Townsfolk: Ah, it looks like one of those robots from the Moontree Lodge. One of its parts must be broken.
Where can I find this Moontree Lodge?
Passing Townsfolk: It's like the wishing well under the Wishing Tree. People toss their hopes and dreams in there, and poof! Before you know it, someone makes them come true.
Passing Townsfolk: You can even say it's part of the Wishing Tree, but wishes made at the lodge are more... public. It's up to the wisher if they want to share.
Passing Townsfolk: Anyhow, I saw that robot hovering around there earlier. Maybe that's where you should start your search.
Thank you.
Rover: The Moontree Lodge... Might as well drop by if it's at the Wishing Tree.
(Head to the designated location)
Patty: Fetching Data. Error. Analysis Failed... Patty. Lost. Wishes. Danger... Xiang-LEE. HELP! HELP!
???: I gotcha.
???: Something seems to have malfunctioned with you. I'll take care of it... One moment.
???: Run onboard diagnostics.
Patty: Command Initiator: Xiangli Yao. Authentication Confirmed. Performing Onboard Diagnostics: No. 231... Onboard Diagnostics Failed...
Patty: Filtering... Wishes... beep, beep... Wishing for a brighter future... glory on the battlefield... abandon hope of loved ones returning home... beep, beep...
Xiangli Yao: Hmm... It's possible that Patty's memory is overloaded with wishes... leading to anomalies mixed within.
Patty: ...Wishes... Analyzing Cause. 21 solutions have been provided... Correction... 12... Correction... 4...
Rover: (Wishes... and solutions...? Could this relate to what Chixia said about "someone" at Moontree Lodge making wishes come true? And Xiangli Yao... The name sounds familiar.)
Xiangli Yao: Perhaps...
Xiangli Yao reaches for a cable-like object at the back of the robot and connects it to his Terminal.
Xiangli Yao: Isolating abnormal data. Running data correction... There, give it another go, Patty.
Patty: Performing Onboard Diagnostics... All Systems Normal. Patty feels full...
Xiangli Yao: That should do the trick for now. But where could the anomalies have...
Xiangli Yao: I apologize for keeping you waiting.
It's okay. Will the robot be okay?
Xiangli Yao: It's just a temporary measure. I'll need to conduct a thorough examination later.
Xiangli Yao: Thank you for returning him to me, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
You know me?
Xiangli Yao: Yes, I've heard a lot about you from my colleagues at the Academy. Many of them are eager to meet you... I hope their enthusiasm hasn't been too overwhelming for you.
And you are...?
Xiangli Yao: Apologies, I haven't even introduced myself yet...
Are you the Principal Investigator?
Xiangli Yao: Well, um... I'd appreciate it if you'd call me by my name instead of "Principal Investigator."
Xiangli Yao: Xiangli Yao, a pleasure to meet you. I regret that I was away during your first visit to the Academy, but I'm glad to finally have the chance to meet you.
Thank you for your help with the Sundial.
Xiangli Yao: I merely provided a few ideas, but... I'm glad I was able to help. I was assisting the Ministry of Development with a damaged surveillance tower. By the time I returned to the lab, you'd already left...
Xiangli Yao: The next time I heard any news about you was regarding the battle at the Norfall Barrens. This year's Moon-Chasing Festival could only have proceeded thanks to your efforts.
Xiangli Yao: Well... Come to think of it, I should be thanking you personally. The Moontree Lodge wouldn't have opened as planned if it weren't for you.
You're welcome. Is this place yours?
Xiangli Yao: I'm afraid I'm not the owner of the Moontree Lodge. I'm just here to assist, collecting and trying to fulfill everyone's wishes.
So you're the mysterious hero granting wishes.
Xiangli Yao: Hero...? It's not as grand as that. It started by trying to help children fulfill their wishes.
Xiangli Yao: However... I do hope you can keep that between us.
I see you prefer to work behind the scenes.
Xiangli Yao: Imagine how disheartening it would be for people to learn their wishes were granted by a single person.
Xiangli Yao: I just want to do something within my power to pass on the joy we've all felt at least once in our lives.
Your secret is safe with me.
Xiangli Yao: Thank you for understanding, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
Xiangli Yao: Seeing everyone's wishes come true and everyone enjoying the festival is enough for me.
Patty: Fulfilling wishes! Happy! What will you taste like, important guest?
...It wants to eat me?
Xiangli Yao: Apologies. Patty doesn't mean anything strange by that.
Xiangli Yao: Patty was born in the Moontree Lodge. It deciphers the emotions behind wishes, analyzing their "structure" in a unique way.
Xiangli Yao: To Patty, every wish has a unique "taste." You can think of it as Patty's way of understanding the world.
Xiangli Yao: Besides bringing Patty back, I presume you're here to make a wish as well, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)?
You've read my mind.
I'd like a tour of the place.
Xiangli Yao: In that case... May I suggest we head over to the Wishing Stall for a chat? It's not far from here.
(Talk to Xiangli Yao)
Xiangli Yao: Welcome... I wish I could extend a warmer greeting, but Patty has run into some technical difficulties and we cannot accept new wishes at Moontree Lodge until I resolve the issue.
Xiangli Yao: I apologize for the inconvenience... I would be glad to take note of your wish and have it prioritized once everything is resolved.
There's so many I don't know what to pick...
Xiangli Yao: Take your time. We still have a little while before the Moon-Chasing Festival.
I can't think of any on the top of my head...
Xiangli Yao: I see... Why don't you take a tour around the Vale? Jinzhou is filled with festivities during this time, and losing yourself in the crowds could very well bring your wish into sharper focus.
Xiangli Yao: ...Speaking from my own experience, of course. Feel free to do as you like.
My wish is for everyone's wishes to come true.
Xiangli Yao: How intriguing... In that case, I promise to do everything I can to make your wish a reality at the festival.
Xiangli Yao: For now, I must concentrate on restoring the Moontree Lodge as quickly as possible.
What's wrong with the Moontree Lodge?
Xiangli Yao: In a nutshell, it appears Patty's malfunction is more than a straightforward data error.
Xiangli Yao: At first, I suspected an overload of Patty's analysis module due to an accumulation of wishes over the years.
Xiangli Yao: However, during my recent testing, I discovered unusual codes embedded within Patty's database. Like a virus, they spread drastically with the addition of each wish.
Xiangli Yao: Additionally... although it was only for a brief moment, I detected abnormal frequency fluctuations after connecting Patty to my Terminal. In theory, a robot's data should not generate such fluctuations...
Did someone tamper with the wishes?
Xiangli Yao: It's too early to draw a conclusion just yet, but I can't leave the matter unresolved.
Then everyone's wishes...
Xiangli Yao: ...It'll only be a matter of time before all the wishes stored in the Moontree Lodge are devoured by this abnormal code.
Xiangli Yao pulls out a tablet showing you four indecipherable files.
Why is it all gibberish?
Are these... wishes?
Xiangli Yao: I've isolated the four wishes with unreadable codes, pinpointing the source of the discrepancies.
Xiangli Yao: I plan to track down whoever made these wishes, try to fulfill them, and uncover the root cause of these anomalies.
Xiangli Yao: But before that, I need to try to decode the wishes corrupted by these anomalies...
Xiangli Yao: To minimize data loss, it would be best to complete this a week before the Moon-Chasing Festival. With careful planning...
Sounds like a difficult job.
Xiangli Yao: It does have its challenges, but everyone's hopes and dreams for the festival are in these wishes. I don't intend to let them down.
Rover: (Yes, Yangyang and the rest... have set their hearts on this festival.)
Anything I can do to help?
Xiangli Yao: I appreciate the gesture... but I wouldn't want to trouble you.
I don't want people losing their wishes.
I'm still counting on you to make my wish come true!
Xiangli Yao: I see. Thank you, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). Well, then... The Moontree Lodge welcomes its newest member!
Xiangli Yao: Seems we have a new friend now, Patty.
Patty: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), Xiangli Yao, and Patty. Wishes come true. Organize Moonlit Fair...
Organize the Moonlit Fair?
Xiangli Yao: Yes. The Lodge opens to the public before the Moonlit Fair, but it still remains an important element of the festivities. The market vendors like to tailor their offerings according to everyone's wishes.
Xiangli Yao: There will be many interesting activities on the day of the Fair, and preparations are well underway. Perhaps some of your friends will be among those attending?
Xiangli Yao: If you're interested, you can go and take a look yourself.
Thanks for the info.
I'll check it out if I have the time.
(Quest Complete)
(Optional - Talk to Xiangli Yao again)
Xiangli Yao: Through these wishes, we get a glimpse of what the Moon-Chasing Festival and the Moonlit Fair mean to everyone. I really hope the event goes smoothly.
About those corrupted wishes...
Xiangli Yao: They caused Patty's malfunction. Some might not even be real wishes but pranks.
Xiangli Yao: Still, we believe each wish sent to the Moontree Lodge carries the writer's hope, and we take every one seriously.
What's the secret of the Moontree Lodge's charm?
Xiangli Yao: The charm of the Moontree Lodge... Haha, I've heard that before, but revealing the mystery would ruin the fun.
Xiangli Yao: Maybe after spending some time with Patty and Xiangli, you'll find the answer yourself.
Who's the founder of the Moontree Lodge?
Xiangli Yao: Shh... The true hero might never want to step into the spotlight. Even if I know who it is, I'll keep their secret.
Xiangli Yao: Just like you're keeping mine. Mysteries need to stay unsolved to keep the magic alive.
Xiangli Yao: Curiosity is a precious quality. I hope we both find the answers we're looking for during the Moon-Chasing Festival.
